_about: Page geometry of venue templates, read from the official author kits. Values marked 'derived' follow from the kit's \documentclass (LaTeX article class defaults, size10.clo) rather than an explicit line in the .sty.

iclr.name: ICLR
iclr.evidence: iclr2026_conference.sty: \textwidth 5.5 true in; body/scriptsize derived (article class 10pt)

icml.name: ICML
icml.evidence: icml2025.sty: \textwidth 6.75in, \columnsep 0.25in (column = (6.75-0.25)/2); example_paper.tex uses \documentclass{article} (10pt default), sizes derived

eccv.name: ECCV
eccv.evidence: ECCV 2026 template main.tex: \documentclass[runningheads]{llncs} + \usepackage[review,year=2026,ID=*****]{eccv} (eccv.sty sets no \textwidth); llncs.cls v2.26: \setlength{\textwidth}{12.2cm}, \LoadClass[twoside]{article} (10pt default; scriptsize derived)

acl.evidence: acl-style-files formatting.md: A4, margins 2.5 cm, 'Column width: 7.7 cm', 'Gap between columns: 0.6 cm' (text width 21.0 - 2x2.5 = 16.0 cm); acl.sty: \def\@normalsize{\@setsize\normalsize{11pt}\xpt\@xpt}, \def\scriptsize{\@setsize\scriptsize{8pt}\viipt\@viipt}; README: 'the latest LaTeX templates for *ACL conferences'
acl.name: ACL

emnlp.evidence: acl-style-files formatting.md: A4, margins 2.5 cm, 'Column width: 7.7 cm', 'Gap between columns: 0.6 cm' (text width 21.0 - 2x2.5 = 16.0 cm); acl.sty: \def\@normalsize{\@setsize\normalsize{11pt}\xpt\@xpt}, \def\scriptsize{\@setsize\scriptsize{8pt}\viipt\@viipt}; README: 'the latest LaTeX templates for *ACL conferences'
emnlp.name: EMNLP

naacl.evidence: acl-style-files formatting.md: A4, margins 2.5 cm, 'Column width: 7.7 cm', 'Gap between columns: 0.6 cm' (text width 21.0 - 2x2.5 = 16.0 cm); acl.sty: \def\@normalsize{\@setsize\normalsize{11pt}\xpt\@xpt}, \def\scriptsize{\@setsize\scriptsize{8pt}\viipt\@viipt}; README: 'the latest LaTeX templates for *ACL conferences'
naacl.name: NAACL

ieee-conference.name: IEEE conference (IEEEtran, conference)
ieee-conference.evidence: IEEEtran.cls V1.8b: \columnsep 1pc, \textwidth 43pc (2 x 21pc + 1pc); conference mode changes only \textheight/top margin; 10pt: \normalsize 10/12pt, \scriptsize 7/8pt

ieee-compsoc-journal.name: IEEE Computer Society journal (IEEEtran, compsoc)
ieee-compsoc-journal.evidence: IEEEtran.cls V1.8b compsoc: \columnsep 12bp, \textwidth 7in + \columnsep ('measurements from proofs show they are using 3.5in columns'); compsoc 10pt: \normalsize 10bp/12bp, \scriptsize 7bp/8bp

ieee-compsoc-conference.name: IEEE Computer Society conference (IEEEtran, compsoc+conference)
ieee-compsoc-conference.evidence: IEEEtran.cls V1.8b compsoc conference: \columnsep 0.25in, \IEEEsettextwidth{0.75in}{0.75in} (letter paper 8.5in - 2 x 0.75in = 7.0in); compsoc 10pt: \scriptsize 7bp

acm-sigconf.name: ACM sigconf (acmart)
acm-sigconf.evidence: acmart.dtx v2.21, sigconf: \geometry{paperwidth=8.5in, columnsep=2pc, inner=54pt, outer=54pt}; \def\ACM@fontsize{9pt} (scriptsize not read: left out)

acm-tog.name: ACM TOG (acmart acmtog)
acm-tog.evidence: acmart.dtx v2.21, acmtog: \geometry{paperwidth=8.5in, columnsep=24pt, inner=52pt, outer=52pt}; \def\ACM@fontsize{9pt} (scriptsize not read: left out)

nature.name: Nature (journal)
nature.evidence: 'Nature's standard figure sizes are 89 mm wide (single column) and 183 mm wide (double column).' 'Maximum text size for all other text should be 7 pt; minimum text size should be 5 pt.'
